description: Use this for one model of a collection (for example Plush Pepe / Heart): rarity, lowest estimate in Stars, TON and USD, price estimate by backdrop and observed asks and sale floors. The Telegram ask is a TON price (telegram_ask_ton); telegram_ask_stars is that ask at the display rate, approximate. Do not use it for one numbered gift (get_gift).

collection.description: Collection name in English or Russian, for example "Plush Pepe".

model.description: Model name inside the collection, for example "Heart".

name: get_model

anyOf.description: Approximate: the TON ask converted to Stars at the display rate, NOT a price payable in Stars. Equals the ask itself only when Telegram lists it in Stars (then telegram_ask_ton is null). Quote telegram_ask_ton as the ask.
The lowest Telegram ask in TON (the price a buyer pays); null when none is known or only a Stars ask exists.

title: Get a gift model
